facts.fact_text: On 26 October 2008 a demonstration was held in Gaziantep to protest about the conditions of detention and alleged ill-treatment of Abdullah Öcalan, the leader of the PKK (an illegal armed organisation).
The Adana Assize Court found it established that the applicant had participated in the demonstration of 26 October 2008.
According to a police report dated 31 December 2008, on 26 October 2008 clashes occurred between demonstrators and the police in three neighbourhoods in Gaziantep.
According to a police report dated 20 January 2009, on 26 October 2008 clashes occurred between demonstrators and the police in three neighbourhoods in Gaziantep.
As a result of the clashes on 26 October 2008 in Gaziantep, eleven police officers were injured.
As a result of the clashes on 26 October 2008 in Gaziantep, police vehicles were damaged by some demonstrators who threw stones.
As a result of the clashes on 26 October 2008 in Gaziantep, public buildings were damaged by some demonstrators who threw stones.
On 18 February 2009 the Adana public prosecutor filed a bill of indictment against the applicant and one other person with the Adana Assize Court.
On 12 March 2009 the applicant was arrested in relation to the charges brought against him in the bill of indictment of 18 February 2009.
Following his arrest on 12 March 2009, the applicant was subsequently detained on remand in relation to the charges brought against him in the bill of indictment of 18 February 2009.

On 9 June 2009 the Adana Assize Court convicted the applicant of membership of an illegal organisation, the PKK, under Article 314 § 2 of the Turkish Criminal Code, on the basis of Article 220 § 6 and Article 314 § 3 of the same Code.
On 9 June 2009 the Adana Assize Court sentenced the applicant to six years and three months' imprisonment for membership of an illegal organisation, the PKK.
On 9 June 2009 the Adana Assize Court convicted the applicant of disseminating propaganda in support of the PKK under section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713).
